title: Stationarity at the Loader Return
statement: For any $l\in\mathbb{N}$, input word $x$, and configuration $c$ of the preparation machine on $x$, if the state of $c$ is the loader's final-counter return state, then one computation step leaves the entire configuration unchanged.
hypotheses_covered: Configuration $c$ of the preparation machine on $x$
The state of $c$ is the specified loader return state
replaced: Every preparation-machine configuration at the loader's complete-row return is left entirely unchanged by one step.
